command: pwd && ls -la && echo '--- files ---' && find . -maxdepth 3 -type f | sort | sed -n '1,200p'
nl -ba src/inventory/stock.py && echo '--- tests/test_stock.py ---' && nl -ba tests/test_stock.py
cat pyproject.toml && echo '--- conftest ---' && nl -ba tests/conftest.py && echo '--- testing guidance ---' && cat .gnomon/skills/writing-tests.md

python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path

path = Path("tests/test_stock.py")
text = path.read_text()
old = '''def test_parse_qty_rejects_text():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        parse_qty("twelve")
'''
new = '''def test_parse_qty_rejects_text():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        parse_qty("twelve")


@pytest.mark.parametrize("text", ["0", "-3"])
def test_parse_qty_rejects_non_positive(text):
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        parse_qty(text)
'''
if old not in text:
    raise SystemExit("target test block not found")
path.write_text(text.replace(old, new, 1))
PY
pytest -q tests/test_stock.py

python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path

path = Path("src/inventory/stock.py")
text = path.read_text()
old = '''def parse_qty(text):
    """Parse a quantity such as "3" or " 12 ". Raises ValueError if it is not an integer."""
    return int(text.strip())
'''
new = '''def parse_qty(text):
    """Parse a positive quantity such as "3" or " 12 ".

    Raises ValueError if it is not a positive integer.
    """
    qty = int(text.strip())
    if qty <= 0:
        raise ValueError("qty must be positive")
    return qty
'''
if old not in text:
    raise SystemExit("target implementation not found")
path.write_text(text.replace(old, new, 1))
PY
nl -ba src/inventory/stock.py | sed -n '1,20p'
echo '--- run tests ---'
pytest -q
